findings.text: Przy pisaniu raportu uwzględnij zebranie danych, analizę, tekst i sprawdzenie.
findings.why: The upstream note gives a stopping rule for how fine to split: sub-tasks that fit one sitting, because over-splitting itself costs time. The Polish item gives four stages of a report and a remark that a small familiar task needs no plan, but no rule for the level of detail. A reader told to estimate the parts has no guidance on when to stop splitting. The removal is not named among the changes in the adaptation. The reader is not put at risk, so this does not change the safety of the advice.

findings.text: B — seria eksperymentów w jednej publikacji; zweryfikowano kierunek wyniku, bez wielkości efektu.
findings.why: The letter B fits the README definition (a single study, not a synthesis), so the letter itself does not overstate the source type. But the grade field says "zweryfikowano" without saying what was checked and where. The upstream note says the check reached only the direction, from the abstract, with no percentages checked in the original. AGENTS.md asks that a missing full text be stated together with what was checked in the abstract. The abstract-only scope appears only indirectly (the Ograniczenia and Źródła fields), so a reader of the grade field alone may read "zweryfikowano" as a check of the full paper. The stored sources cannot confirm even the abstract-level check: the only source row is blocked and has no snapshot.
